title: Relabel Launch command history
summary: Relabel the Launch History command review so it is no longer rendered or described as an evidence panel.
reason: The History tab command review contains selectable rows and diagnostics buttons, so presenting it with an evidence badge and advisory-evidence copy made an interactive review surface look like read-only evidence.
behavior_before: Launch History rendered the command history section as data-panel-type="evidence", showed a Commands Evidence heading with an evidence badge, and described accepted command correlation as advisory evidence.
behavior_after: Launch History renders the command history section as an interactive panel with a Command History heading and uses advisory context/checklist context language for command review details.
